prompt:
Game enemy lineup sheet: TEN different melee enemy sprites of one lightning clan arranged in a strict grid of 5 columns by 2 rows on ONE image, every character in its own invisible cell of equal size, each cell one fifth of the image width and one half of the image height. The top row holds the light, fast units and the bottom row the casters and the heavy units. Each character is drawn with the body shape of its role, so the role reads from the silhouette alone: the archer and the javelin thrower are tall, thin and long-limbed, the duelist is lean and leans forward with sharp angles, the brute is a wide square block, the lord is tall and commanding. Each is a chunky grim fantasy cartoon character, never cute, never a mascot. All TEN are in SIDE VIEW from a high top-down camera, facing RIGHT toward the right edge of the image, the body turned only about 30 degrees toward the viewer, the far arm and leg partly hidden behind the body, standing UPRIGHT in a calm ready stance with both feet on ONE horizontal ground line, the head tilted about 8 degrees forward. Every biped character has TWO ARMS OF EXACTLY THE SAME SIZE AND LENGTH and TWO LEGS OF EXACTLY THE SAME SIZE AND LENGTH; the Storm Lynx stands on FOUR LEGS of exactly the same size. Every character has a face built from the fewest bold shapes, TWO BOLD GLOWING eye shapes with no pupils, skin in two flat tones. Layout rules: each character is VERY SMALL inside its cell and centered horizontally in it, with the soles of the feet on a line at 70% of the cell height, a very wide empty background space on both sides of every character and an empty band above the head; the ten characters are far apart, clearly separated by empty background, and no weapon, hand or cloak ever reaches the neighbouring cell. Sizes: characters 1 to 8 are all the same medium size, even the small ones, with the same amount of detail; characters 9 and 10 are larger, about one and a half times that height; the Tempest Brute is the widest and the Thunder Lord the tallest of all ten.
TOP ROW, left to right:
1. THUNDER RAIDER, melee, average build about 3.8 heads tall: a leather jerkin with iron shoulder studs, a spiked iron cap, a braided beard, ONE one-handed warhammer held low in the hand on the LEFT side of the image.
2. VOLT DUELIST, assassin, agile and muscular about 4.3 heads tall: an athletic fast body leaning forward in a ready crouch with sharp angular shapes, a cloth mask wrapped over the nose and mouth so only two glowing violet eyes show, bare muscular forearms in leather bracers, a short cape, TWO short curved daggers, one in each hand, held low.
3. STORM LYNX, on four legs, no weapon: a lean athletic big cat with long legs, tufted ears, a ruff of spiky fur, glowing violet eyes, a short tail held low; all four paws on the ground line.
4. GALE ARCHER, archer, slender about 4 heads tall: a tall thin body with long thin arms and long legs, narrow shoulders, a hooded head and a feathered cap, a quiver on the back, ONE recurved bow with thick limbs held low in the hand on the LEFT side of the image.
5. BOLT THROWER, javelin thrower, slender about 4 heads tall: a tall thin athletic body with long limbs, a leather chest strap, ONE long javelin shaped like a zigzag lightning bolt held in the hand on the LEFT side of the image, tilted about 40 degrees forward, its tip no higher than the top of the head.
BOTTOM ROW, left to right:
6. STORM MAGE, mage, slender about 4 heads tall: a long robe cinched at the waist and flaring at the hem, a pointed hat, ONE short staff topped with a crystal held low in the hand on the LEFT side of the image, the crystal at chest height, no taller than her head.
7. THUNDER DRUMMER, support, hunched: a bent figure in a patched coat with a feathered headdress, a drum slung at the hip, ONE short mallet in the hand on the LEFT side of the image held low.
8. THUNDER KNIGHT, elite melee, average broad build about 3.8 heads tall: plate armour with a lightning-bolt emblem on the chest, a helm with a crest, ONE broad sword with a wide blade held low in the hand on the LEFT side of the image.
9. TEMPEST BRUTE, brawny: a gigantic square body about 3 heads tall, huge square shoulders, short thick legs, a low centre of gravity, two enormous iron gauntlets as fists, no weapon, empty hands.
10. THUNDER LORD, the chief: a tall commanding figure about 4.2 heads tall with a small head about 22 percent of the height, legs about 45 percent of the height, wide angular shoulder plates, a narrow waist, an upright chest-out stance, a long cape flaring behind, a tall horned crown-helm with two glowing violet eyes, hard angular shapes everywhere, no belly and no round shapes, ONE two-handed battle axe with a broad blade held low in front with the head down.
COLOUR PLAN with strict harmony: the whole clan shares ONE dominant hue, a golden yellow (hue about 50 degrees), used in four values only: shadow #6B4A08, base #D9A416, light #F2CF4A, top highlight #FBEFA8, for the armour, the cloaks, the robes and the trim. ONE warm family for the leather, the fur and the skin: leather #7A5236 with shadow #4A3022, skin tan #C99A6A with shadow #98704A. ONE accent family, electric violet #8A5CFF with shadow #5A34C8, ONLY on the glowing eyes, the crystals and the sparks. Rules: large areas are mid values; only the eyes and the crystals are strongly saturated; every shadow is a darker tint of its own colour, never black; every light is a warmer, paler tint of its own colour, never pure white; the outline of every character is a dark mauve-brown #2B1E22. The higher the rank, the more plate and crystal. Iron and steel #8A8C8E with shadow #5B5E62; the trousers and cloth are dark brown #4A3626.
Everything stays inside the frame with a margin on every side, every weapon tip at least 20% below the top edge of its cell. Background: one flat solid pure magenta color (#FF00FF) everywhere, no gradient, no ground, no cast shadow, no grid lines, no cell borders, no numbers, no text, no scenery. Do not use magenta or pink anywhere on the subject.
Style: stylized 2D vector cartoon game art for a fantasy tower defense game, in the manner of a chunky cartoon enemy illustration, each character designed to read at about 60 pixels tall. Chunky rounded volumes, big simple shapes with a bold silhouette, hands and weapons enlarged and legs shrunk. Flat solid fills in 3 to 4 stacked hard-edged tones with the large areas in MID values; no gradients, no airbrush, no painterly texture, no noise, no realistic rendering. Thick clean dark mauve-brown outlines (never pure black), thicker on the outer silhouette and thinner inside, rounded joins. A few small flat speckle spots on large surfaces. Medium detail only: bold simple shapes, no fine engraving, no tiny patterns, no thin lines. High top-down camera tilted about 60 degrees; light comes from the top-left.
